sources_fetched.title: The AI Work Platform for People & Agents | monday.com

record.name: Monday.com
record.one_liner: monday.com provides a GraphQL Platform API and OAuth 2.0 / personal token authentication for building project management integrations and apps.

auth.notes: The platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens passed in the Authorization header. OAuth 2.0 is also supported for marketplace apps.

access.notes: Developers can create a free developer account and obtain an API token or create apps via the Developer Center directly.

api_surface.notes: The public platform API is built with GraphQL.

mcp.notes: The platform mentions a hosted MCP url and developer MCP for connecting agents and IDEs.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: API uses personal API tokens for authentication
evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
The monday GraphQL API is part of the monday apps framework.

evidence.claim: Free developer accounts can be created to test APIs
evidence.quote: For building and testing apps or API integrations without touching production data, use a free developer account
Use our native integration, or manually connect with our hosted MCP url.
